observation.command:
cd /workspace && set -a && . ./.env && set +a
echo "=== Keycloak token for local user (password grant via local-client) ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/tok.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 \
  -X POST "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  --data-urlencode "grant_type=password" \
  --data-urlencode "client_id=local-client" \
  --data-urlencode "client_secret=$LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode "scope=openid email profile"
node -e 'const t=require("/tmp/tok.json"); console.log(Object.keys(t)); if(t.access_token){const p=JSON.parse(Buffer.from(t.access_token.split(".")[1],"base64").toString());console.log("sub",p.sub,"email",p.email,"preferred_username",p.preferred_username,"exp",new Date(p.exp*1000).toISOString())} else console.log(JSON.stringify(t))'
